Test Case 4: Run External Validation Harness

Input: Execute external-activity-system-validation-harness.ts

Expected Output:
- 3/3 tests pass
- 0 failures
- Execution time: <60 seconds
- Exit code: 0

Validation Method:
1. Execute: npx ts-node tests/validation-harnesses/external-activity-system-validation-harness.ts
2. Capture output and parse results
3. Extract pass count, fail count from output (format: 'X/Y tests passed')
4. Measure execution time
5. Check exit code
6. Return PASS if 3/3 tests passed and exit code 0, FAIL otherwise

Historical: YES - This test can run without LLM by executing harness and parsing output
